Subject: Solaris bank activation and remittance format

Hi Marcus / Marissa,

Thanks for the warm onboarding call this morning. Per our procurement checklist, I'm attaching the signed bank authorization and a voided check for Solaris Systems. Please confirm when the account is activated for ACH and provide the remittance reference format so our AR team can map incoming payments.

Attachments:
- Solaris_Bank_Authorization_Form.pdf (pdf)
- solaris_voided_check.jpg (image)

A few specifics from our side: we send remits with invoice numbers in the format SOL-INV-YYYY-##### and include a 10-digit customer reference (our internal AR tag). If you can confirm the exact remit field Redwood will populate (e.g., structured remittance / ACH addendum), we can update our EFT feed.

Also happy to sign any vendor setup verification you need (DocuSign link below).

Thanks,

Jenny — thanks for the docs, received. Quick checklist from our side before we can flip the switch:

- We need the bank account verification form notarized OR a recent bank statement that matches the account name on the authorization form.
- Please confirm the ACH routing number again (we saw it on the form but want to avoid typos).
- Confirm the remit reference you prefer be included in the payment Advice (we can include SOL-INV-YYYY-##### or your 10-digit tag).

Marissa on our team will handle the finance activation once we have the verified proof. Laura, looping you in for procurement PO mapping (this will be tied to PO #45678 once live).

If you can reply with the second proof (bank statement as PDF is fine) and confirm the remit field, we'll target activation by end of day Friday.

Best,
Marcus

Redwood Inference

- Remittance advice will carry the invoice number in the SOL-INV-YYYY-##### slot; we also include an optional reference field where we will place your 10-digit AR tag when present.
